The completed original-pixel review therefore carries forward without inference.

### Blocking findings

1. **P1 — visual authority is not authenticated when the external corpus is absent.** In `scripts/vlm/issue_1775_p4_newton_semantic_kg.py:916-924`, `--check` rebuilds the reviewed source only when `CIE9709_CORPUS_ROOT` is available. `make_config()` authenticates the reviewed JSON and provider source, but not `scripts/vlm/issue_1775_p4_newton_visual_authority.py`. Changing `QUESTION_VISUAL_FACTS` while leaving materialized outputs unchanged can therefore still produce `deterministic_rebuild: PASS` in the normal corpus-unavailable environment. The authority module must be bound into authenticated inputs or otherwise validated without requiring the physical corpus. Existing thread: https://github.com/Samsen879/ciecopilot-home/pull/1781#discussion_r3677081152

2. **P2 — three-body connected systems omit the third body branch.** The fixed branch loop at `scripts/vlm/issue_1775_p4_newton_semantic_kg.py:510-527` emits only `body_a_equation` and `body_b_equation`. Exact materialized records for `qrow_9709_s25_qp_42_q05::q05/b` and `qrow_9709_w21_qp_43_q06::q06/b` contain no `body_c_equation`, despite the authenticated visual authority and model definition requiring all three bodies/two strings. Existing thread: https://github.com/Samsen879/ciecopilot-home/pull/1781#discussion_r3677081155

3. **P2 — opposite motion directions are collapsed into one Newton branch.** `qrow_9709_s19_qp_42_q04::q04` requires distinct uphill and downhill force systems with resistance reversing direction, but its exact delta contains only the Newton branch `positive_motion_direction`; its kinematics/energy supports do not represent the second Newton equation topology. Existing thread: https://github.com/Samsen879/ciecopilot-home/pull/1781#discussion_r3677081160

4. **P2 — power-only candidate parts use the wrong procedure model.** The `energy` alias at `scripts/vlm/issue_1775_p4_newton_semantic_kg.py:148-152` resolves to `apply_work_energy`. Exact records for `qrow_9709_m23_qp_42_q04::q04/b` and `qrow_9709_s20_qp_43_q02::q02/b` are power-only (`P = Fv`) but advertise work/displacement/energy-state steps. They need a distinct canonical power procedure. Existing thread: https://github.com/Samsen879/ciecopilot-home/pull/1781#discussion_r3677081163

5. **P2 — required power support is missing from Newton-primary solutions.** Exact records for `qrow_9709_m19_qp_42_q04::q04/ii`, `qrow_9709_s20_qp_41_q02::q02/b`, and `qrow_9709_s24_qp_41_q04::q04` contain only Newton system/body branches even though the MS solution also requires the power relation. `SUPPORTING_METHODS` needs exact-part-bound power support using the dedicated power procedure. Existing thread: https://github.com/Samsen879/ciecopilot-home/pull/1781#discussion_r3677081169

- Visually inspected **73/73 authenticated bundles**, including every original: **117 QP + 162 MS = 279 images**. No broken QP/MS chain or visual contradiction was found.
- Independently authenticated the physical bundle and image SHA-256 chains; all reviewed refs are portable and complete.
- Independently audited the materialized graph: 73 questions, 207 parts, 325 P4-04 procedure instances, 888 step instances; unique identities, no dangling step-to-instance links, registry embeddings exact, candidate-only foreign support not promoted, and all declared hard gates zero.
- P4-01 through P4-03 source/delta artifacts are byte-preserved; P4-03 receipts match `828beac86e8ec1d73feb3cea3bc9f76a668b318ca0851aa7869b425a08b14ded` and `107a23977363f0644a783c14fd93976702f1bca75c6e9b052b4e3977cace36d4`.
- `python3 scripts/vlm/issue_1775_p4_newton_semantic_kg.py --check` — PASS, including deterministic rebuild and physical corpus authentication.
- Explicit focused chain — **97/97 PASS**:
  - P4-01 forces/equilibrium: 10
  - P4-02 kinematics: 9
  - P4-03 momentum: 12
  - P4-04 Newton: 9
  - future producer: 30
  - future harness: 27
- `git diff --check` — PASS; exact review worktree remained clean.

- `PR Workflow Trust Boundary` — PASS
- `S1 Contract Gate` — PASS
- `Backend/platform ESLint` and `ESLint` — infrastructure-only failures before repository correctness results: the promisor-filtered self-hosted checkout omitted tracked `eslint.config.js` and `artifacts/lint/lint-baseline.json`. The local changed-files ratchet passed with 0 targeted files / 0 regressions. These runner checkout failures are not additional semantic-code findings.

## Independent exact-head re-review: PASS

1. The checked-in visual-authority module is now bound by path/SHA-256/byte length in the reviewed source and immutable provider state. `--check` authenticates it before physical-corpus availability is considered; provider binding and cache identity include the same receipt. Corrupt-receipt rejection and corpus-unavailable regression coverage pass.
2. The two cited three-body records now include `body_c_equation`; the complete QP/MS images show three bodies/two strings and the MS equations support the topology.
3. `qrow_9709_s19_qp_42_q04::q04` now has separate `uphill_motion_equation` and `downhill_motion_equation` branches whose steps reverse resistance consistently with the QP/MS.
4. Both power-only candidate parts now use `9709.p4.pm.relate_power_force_speed` and `9709.p4.qt.power_force_speed_candidate`, not work-energy.
5. All three Newton-primary power records now retain Newton as score-owning and add exactly one candidate-only, exact-part-bound power support, with no `alternative_to` and no promotion.

- P4-01 through P4-03 reviewed-source/delta bytes exactly match base and the prior reviewed head. P4-03 remains:
